purpose: ESPP disposition comparator ported from ApexLogics Apex #110 (AL-117). For an ESPP purchase (price paid after the 15% statutory discount, offering-price FMV at grant, current price, shares, grant and purchase dates) and a tax profile (ordinary income, single/MFJ filing, optional as-of date), the node computes the disqualifying and qualifying disposition outcomes side by side: ordinary income (the discount, or its IRC 423(c)-capped qualifying analog), LTCG tax at the 2026 section 1(h) thresholds layered on ordinary income, the marginal ordinary rate from the 2026 section 1 tables, the break-even qualifying-disposition date (later of grant + 2 years + 1 day and purchase + 1 year + 1 day), and after-tax proceeds under each path. Tax constants are Rev. Proc. 2025-32 and IRC 423, fetched and quoted in the payload CITES.md. Out of scope: state tax, AMT, employment-tax treatment, wash-sale rules.
